title: Meet Students Where They Are: Student-Prefix Teacher Adaptation for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.03133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) mitigates the student's exposure bias by optimizing on student-generated trajectories. However, student-generated prefixes may contain reasoning errors or follow patterns unfamiliar to the teacher, undermining the reliability of its token-level supervision. This degradation becomes more pronounced as prefixes grow longer. To address this teacher-side distribution mismatch, we propose Student-Prefix Teacher Adaptation (SPTA), which adapts the teacher to the states on which it is queried during distillation. Specifically, before OPD starts, we collect student rollout prefixes with random lengths and continually train the teacher to continue from the prefixes using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). translated_title: 因材施教：面向在线策略蒸馏的学生前缀教师自适应
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏通过在学生生成的轨迹上进行优化，缓解了学生模型的曝光偏差。然而，学生生成的前缀可能包含推理错误，或遵循教师所不熟悉的模式，从而削弱了教师提供的token级监督的可靠性。随着前缀变长，这种性能退化变得更加明显。为了解决这种教师侧的分布不匹配问题，我们提出了学生前缀教师自适应（SPTA），使教师模型适应其在蒸馏过程中被查询到的状态。具体而言，在OPD开始之前，我们收集随机长度的学生滚动生成前缀，并使用可验证奖励的强化学习持续训练教师从这些前缀继续推理。通过将每个前缀视为上下文并奖励正确的最终答案，教师学会从学生诱导的状态中恢复，而不是模仿学生的推理方式。随后，经过自适应的教师……
tldr: 提出SPTA方法，在蒸馏前用可验证奖励的强化学习训练教师从随机长度的学生生成前缀继续推理并得出正确答案，使教师适应学生所处的状态分布，从而提升在线策略蒸馏中token级监督的可靠性。
en_tdlr: SPTA adapts the teacher to student states by training it with RLVR to continue from random-length student-generated prefixes and reach correct final answers, thereby improving the reliability of token-level supervision in on-policy distillation.
